parole.significato: A member of a tribe of the Mi'kmaq Native American people of Aroostook County, Maine.
parole.testo: From Malecite-Passamaquoddy Wool-ahs-took (“good river for everything”).

parole.significato: A member of an Algonquian people who reside in Maine (US) and New Brunswick (Canada).
parole.testo: From Malecite-Passamaquoddy Peskotomuhkat (“those who spear pollock / those who live where there are pollock”).

parole.testo: From the placenames, which are named for the tribe; the tribe's name is an Anglicization of their autonym, and the word is thus ultimately from Malecite-Passamaquoddy.
